colors.secondary_usage: Footer headings, icon lists, secondary brand elements
colors.accent_usage: Hover states, active nav, button hover, CTA hover
colors.gold_accent_usage: Theme hover accent, date markers, event booking buttons
colors.heading_text_usage: Section heading text on light backgrounds

Your Story. Our History. Ashtabula County.
Ashtabula County Has a Story Worth Telling
brand_narrative.positioning: The digital history and genealogy platform for Ashtabula County Historical Society — connecting 185+ years of heritage with modern research tools.

visual_style.color_scheme: Deep teal dominant, with terra cotta accents and sky blue highlights
visual_style.photography_style: Historical photographs, museum interiors, local landmarks (harbor, bridges, covered bridges)

implementation_notes: Use Elementor global palette for primary brand fidelity
Use logo colors (#005048, #A8D0E6, #C85A4E) only when replicating the logo itself or creating print-adjacent materials
Lora at 0 letter-spacing for headings — natural width gives authority without tracking
Archivo at 16px/28px (1.75 line-height) is critical for readability with historical/archive text content
No variable fonts needed — site only loads 4 fixed weights of Archivo and 2 of Lora
On dark backgrounds (nav #00614B, footer #2A2A2A), text is always #F5F5F5
On light backgrounds, headings are #25282e, body text is #555555
For accessibility: Archivo at 16px/28px with #555555 passes WCAG AA (~5.3:1 contrast). For <14px text, bump to #444444
